title: The Innocent man in the court
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：innocent　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 innocent 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the director wrote of ① an innocent man in the court in the poster, and everybody in the theatre said at once that it was ② so innocent that nobody in the theatre would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the director, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the innocent ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the innocent man in the court that anybody there had ever seen, or so the poster for August 1946 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too innocent to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the actor who had come to help; the innocent ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an innocent question of the child, and said that no actor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as innocent as the question of the child they had once had in the old theatre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was innocent or not, and he said so.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the poster. What the line asked for was ⑦ something innocent, and nothing besides. The actor from the next theatre called the whole plan ⑧ quite innocent; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the poster kept the names of the innocent ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962, in public, she wrote of another innocent man in the court in the same poster, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less innocent than anybody had expected. ⑩ The innocent question of the child that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1964, was the one she could never quite name; the innocent ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 无辜（前置定语 an innocent man in the court：1952 年导演在戏报里记下的那件无辜的男人）
B. adj. 无辜／天真（两处加强说法：so innocent that … 与 no less innocent than …）
C. adj. 无辜／天真（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 无辜（表语 too innocent to do：母亲觉得它太无辜，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 天真（前置定语 an innocent question of the child：叔叔把整件事称作一桩天真的问题）
F. adj. 天真（同级比较 as innocent as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩孩子天真的问题相比）
G. adj. 天真（后置定语 something innocent：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 天真（受程度副词修饰 quite innocent：那位演员的评价）

items.q: an innocent man in the court
the innocent man in the court that
an innocent question of the child
The innocent question of the child that

answers.why: innocent 意为“无辜”，1952 年导演在戏报里记下的是“一件无辜的男人”，此处作前置定语 an innocent man in the court。
innocent 意为“无辜”，此处用 so innocent that 结构，说它无辜到戏院里没人敢靠近。
innocent 意为“无辜”，戏报上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的无辜法庭上无辜的男人，等于最高级的说法。
innocent 意为“无辜”，母亲认为这件东西“太无辜了，谁也用不上”，too innocent to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
innocent 意为“天真”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩天真的问题”，此处作前置定语 an innocent question of the child。
innocent 意为“天真”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩孩子天真的问题一样天真”，同级比较用 as innocent as。
innocent 意为“天真”，戏报上那半行字要的是“天真的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something innocent。
innocent 意为“天真”，邻戏院来的那位演员认为这套计划“相当天真”，quite 修饰原级 innocent。
innocent 意为“天真”，no less innocent than 表示“其天真不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之天真不亚于任何人的预料。
innocent 意为“天真”，母亲 1964 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的天真问题”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，导演在戏报里记下了一件无辜的男人。（an innocent man in the court）
它无辜到戏院里没有一个人敢靠近。（so innocent that …）
母亲觉得它太无辜，谁也用不上。（too innocent to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩天真的问题。（an innocent question of the child）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩孩子天真的问题一样天真。（as innocent as …）
到了 1959 年，戏报上只剩半行字：要的是一件天真的东西。（something innocent）
answers: In 1952 the director wrote of an innocent man in the court in the poster.
It was so innocent that nobody in the theatre would go near it.
My mother thought it too innocent to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an innocent question of the child.
He said nobody would call it as innocent as the question of the child they had once had.
By 1959 the poster asked for nothing but something innocent.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 innocent 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the director wrote of an innocent man in the court in the poster, and nobody forgot it.
It was the innocent man in the court that anybody there had ever seen, or so the poster says.
My mother thought it too innocent to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an innocent question of the child, and nobody argued with him.
The actor from the next theatre called the plan quite innocent, and everybody laughed.
The innocent ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
